scope: How frozen pilot method classes are instantiated on each new provider world without graph-WB tuning.

allowed_before_graph_prediction: new world's frozen public I1 cards
public graph mechanics only after provider reconstructions are frozen
forbidden: Step-0 WB outcomes except frozen query regions

M1.start_domain: base M1-v2 declared domain for every provider; do not inherit the historical ProviderC special-case merely because of provider identity

boundary_gate.log_mu_rule: if implicated, expand only the implicated log-scale edge by one decade
boundary_gate.log_kappa_rule: if implicated, expand only the implicated log-scale edge by one decade
boundary_gate.cv_rule: no automatic new CV expansion is invented in Phase 5; if the selected candidate remains/lands within the boundary fraction of a CV edge, mark unresolved
boundary_gate.after_expansion: rerun the same frozen M1 procedure with the same algorithm and evidence banks
boundary_gate.stop_rule: if the post-expansion selected candidate remains within boundary_fraction of any expanded edge, do not expand again; mark M1 NOT_INSTANTIABLE for that provider world and do not use graph-WB to repair it

M2.provider_domain: final declared M1 domain after any permitted public-I1-only one-round expansion
M2.failure_semantics: If a provider world cannot freeze 3 confirmed members per provider under the frozen local rules, mark M2 NOT_INSTANTIABLE for that provider world. Do not widen thresholds after graph outcomes. Continue other methods and report the status.

M3.proposal_source: Phase-5 M2 nonadaptive 48-point LHS bank for each provider, before GP adaptive additions
M3.discrepancy: Jeffreys-smoothed Bernoulli KL averaged over complete public I1 surface with H>0
M3.joint_weight: product of the three provider weights

graph_support.rule: sort full 48^3 joint support by descending product weight and retain fixed ranks 1..14
graph_support.allocation: same integer minimax variance-bound allocation as pilot over Top14 renormalized weights

M3.truncation_guard: omitted-mass bound is internal approximation to full finite-support M3 expectation, not a truth-error certificate
